summary: Daily iOS Release delivery builds the real Fabric bridge, keys artifact reuse on the compiled XCFramework content, and refuses missing frameworks or disabled-stub apps.

compatibility.detail: The daily app links Fabric with proof and offline Debug disabled. Carrier selection remains opt-in; no wire protocol change.

downtime.detail: No live delivery or device change.

manual.detail: Source only. An operator separately repins ST_IOS_SCRIPT to the reviewed updater before scheduled delivery uses it. The Mac builder needs both iOS Rust targets.

recovery.detail: Failed framework or linkage checks publish no installable artifact. Existing deployment approval and monotonic version protections remain unchanged.
